messages:
maria: Heads-up team — scheduling a CMK rotation + failure drill Tue 09:30 PT. Purpose: validate snapshot/backup decrypt fallback paths, RBAC, and audit ingestion. Need owners for RBAC, restore, observability.

sam: I'm available. Recommend we run against a copied snapshot in a test account, not touching live masters.

alyssa: Agreed. Also want to confirm CloudTrail events surface in our audit pipeline before the drill. If not, alerts will be blind.

jordan: I'll add a preflight: query for Decrypt events and KMS CreateGrant events in the test account. Example: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=CreateGrant`.

leo: RBAC note: we'll need a short-lived role for the rotation orchestrator + an uploader service account for restore jobs. Recommend 12m max session.

maria: @leo can you own the IAM patch? I'll write the runbook and coordinate infra.

leo: Yep. Plan: `rotate-drill-role` with permissions kms:CreateGrant, kms:Decrypt, kms:ListGrants. Add condition restricting by `aws:SourceArn` to the restore job Lambda. SessionDuration = 600s.

maria: Add a grant tag `drill=true` so we can filter in logs. Also ensure the restore job emits `grantId` and `keyId` in its metadata.

encops-bot: NOTICE: CMK policy edits detected. Backup CMK policy must be saved prior to changes. Auto-policy-check will block diffs > 7 lines.

sam: Quick Q: do we simulate CMK Disable or simulate grant expiry? Which is higher fidelity for our customers?

maria: We'll run two passes: 1) disable CMK (blocks all decrypts) then recover; 2) revoke ephemeral grant mid-restore to validate partial failure handling.

alyssa: Obs: capture full error payloads for AccessDenied — include errorCode, principal, grantId, keyId, and requestId. Map to our incident taxonomy.

jordan: I'll instrument the restore wrapper to log those fields and emit a structured event to our audit-log stream.

leo: IAM PR coming. I'll include rollback steps (recreate grant, re-enable key, reapply old policy).

maria: Runbook snippet for restore (to include in playbook):
```
# assume role
CREDS=$(aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/rotate-drill-role --role-session-name drill)
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo $CREDS | jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo $CREDS | jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo $CREDS | jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
# create grant
GRANT_ID=$(aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222222222222:key/abcd-ef12 --grantee-principal arn:aws:sts::222222222222:assumed-role/rotate-drill-role/drill --operations Decrypt --name drill-grant --query GrantId --output text)
# run restore tool
restore-tool --backup s3://redwood-backups/drill --decrypt-grant-id $GRANT_ID --log-meta grantId=$GRANT_ID,keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222222222222:key/abcd-ef12
```

sam: I'll be restore lead. I'll rehearse the steps in staging tonight.

alyssa: I'll provision the dashboard and saved queries, post link once ready. Need sample events to validate schema.

maria: Also: include a step to verify backup object metadata contains SSE-CMK headers and that uploader adds `sse-cmk: true` tag.

encops-bot: REMINDER: run CMK policy diff check. If policy changed, paste the pre-change policy into the runbook.

leo: PR posted: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/rotate-drill-iam-2026.patch

maria: Great. We'll do a 30m blameless retro in #eng-postmortems after. If anyone else wants to help, ping me. :thumbsup:
